title: PTP Over Wide Area Networks With Offset Measurement Outlier Filtering
authors: Víctor Vázquez, Carlos Megías, Carmen Vélez, Héctor Esteban, Javier Díaz, Eduardo Ros
locator: Sections IV-A/B, Figures 3–5 and field evaluation
finding: Two remote sites use GNSS common-view and local frequency comparison to check real PTP synchronization. The lab replay injects path-delay variation. Inspect measured offset separately in the archive.
rights: Publicly readable source; link and original notes only.

title: Descriptor: A Hybrid Indoor and Indoor–Outdoor Positioning Multitechnology Dataset (HYMN)
authors: Muhammad Ammad, Albrecht Michler, Paul Schwarzbach, Jonas Ninnemann, Hagen Ußler, Oliver Michler
locator: Acquisition workflow, Multitechnology Merged Data Alignment and Table III; repository DOI in Data Availability
finding: Industrial hall reference locations were surveyed. Technology streams are indexed by point and timestamp; Table III indices are explicitly illustrative. NTP to a shared reference does not measure per-link propagation.
rights: Publicly readable source; link and original notes only.

title: Assessing Long Distance Communication Alternatives for the Remote Control of AGVs
authors: Ronal Bejarano, Roope Pääkkönen, Jan Olaf Blech, Ian Peake, Peter Herrmann, Valeriy Vyatkin
locator: Section III, equations for latency/throughput, Table I, Figures 4–5
finding: The study characterizes the communication path needed for low-bandwidth remote commands using ping and throughput tests. Three SQLite records are available. RTT aggregates do not include a hardware-actuation response.
rights: IEEE author-accepted manuscript. Source pointers and factual annotations.

title: Towards enhanced live visualization based on communication delay prediction for remote AGV operation
authors: Ronal Bejarano, Udayanto Dwi Atmojo, Jan Olaf Blech, Valeriy Vyatkin
finding: A position estimator uses path and predicted delay; the delay predictor receives RTT samples. Predictive display is a different endpoint from a remotely triggered actuator measurement.
rights: IEEE author manuscript. Source pointers and factual annotations.

title: Validation of 5G capabilities for industrial robotics
finding: Kista mobile navigation, stopping margin, docking and manipulation include explicit wired references and measured task outcomes. Additional 5G traffic emulates another device; no per-packet paired release identified here.
rights: Public technical deliverable. Publisher PDF remains at the project website; only independently calculated table contrasts reproduced.

title: 5G-Based Testbed for Trials with Industrial Robotics
locator: D2.2 v1.0 (final, 2022-01-31), system architecture and application realization
finding: Documents the AMR navigation, robot-arm and edge components supporting the D2.3 validations. Common project and testbed; not independent trial replication.
rights: Public technical deliverable. Publisher PDF remains at the project website; only independently calculated table contrasts reproduced.

title: Latency characterization in real-time robot supervision via network camera system
locator: Instrumentation for P1–P4, Table 2, Discussion and Table 3
finding: Host command logging and an independent high-speed camera observe different endpoints. Full control-to-crawler-motion and transmission were measured over different-sized samples. A difference of summary statistics is not an individual motor delay.
rights: CC BY 4.0; original derived contrasts credited to Van Dieu Nguyen and Tadashi Chosa.

title: Delay compensated state estimation for Telepresence robot navigation
finding: Physical robot trajectories and an external Vicon reference support estimation tests with fixed or Gaussian/Gamma delayed measurements. The injected delay distribution is not a measured radio-link distribution.
rights: Publicly readable source; link and original notes only.

title: Real-Time Video Latency Measurement between a Robot and Its Remote Control Station: Causes and Mitigation
authors: Admir Kaknjo, Muzaffar Rao, Edin Omerdic, Luke Robinson, Daniel Toal, Thomas Newe
finding: Dedicated stratum-1 NTP and video timestamping were used to evaluate an IP-camera chain for a miniature ROV. The LAN and Internet ranges describe delivered video latency, not motor response.
rights: Publicly readable source; link and original notes only.

title: Towards Real-Time Generation of Delay-Compensated Video Feeds for Outdoor Mobile Robot Teleoperation
authors: Neeloy Chakraborty, Yixiao Fang, Andre Schreiber, Tianchen Ji, Zhe Huang, Aganze Mihigo, Cassidy Wall, Abdulrahman Almana, Katherine Driggs-Campbell

finding: Outdoor field experiments and offline reconstruction tests evaluate predicted video. The associated offline RGB/depth/pose archive is a lead, without validation of cross-host packet timestamps.
rights: Publicly readable source; link and original notes only.

title: Measurement of latency during real-time wireless video transmission for remote supervision of autonomous agricultural machines
authors: Mitchell Green, Danny D. Mann, Ekram Hossain
locator: Publisher abstract/Crossref; cited in Nguyen and Chosa Table 3
finding: Field-case comparator for wireless video supervision. Script-level timestamps, motion response and raw recordings were not checked.

title: Toward an AI-Enabled Connected Industry: AGV Communication and Sensor Measurement Datasets
authors: Rodrigo Hernangómez, Alexandros Palaios, Cara Watermann, Daniel Schäufele, Philipp Geuer, Rafail Ismayilov, Mohammad Parvini, Anton Krause, Martin Kasparick, Thomas Neugebauer, Oscar D. Ramos-Cantor, Hugues Tchouankem, Jose Leon Calvo, Bo Chen, Gerhard Fettweis, Sławomir Stańczak
